run_health_check: run a health check against an HTTP/2 gRPC server to verify it is live
run_health_check_custom_host: run a health check against a gRPC server on a custom host and port
test_http2_connection: test an HTTP/2 connection to a gRPC server by sending a POST request
test_grpc_encoding_header: test that a gRPC server response includes the grpc-encoding header
review_health_check_script: review the health check script that verifies gRPC server availability before tests
